note: 500 underwriter questions that reached Ledger's gateway over one business day. served_by names what answered: semantic_cache is a stored answer returned for a similar question, primary is the provider the gateway prefers, fallback is the provider it fails over to, and refused is a request the gateway's own rate limiter rejected so no model ever saw it. served_correct is whether the underwriter got the right answer, graded later against the operative clause, and it is false for a refused request. primary_replay_correct is a separate audit: the same question replayed fresh against the primary provider, uncached and unthrottled. For a row the gateway forwarded to the primary provider, the replay reproduces what the underwriter saw.
audit: Every one of the 500 questions was replayed, so the audit column is complete rather than sampled.
